name: Bluesky Search
label: Bluesky AT Protocol - Social Search
description: Read-only Bluesky AT Protocol search node. Calls XRPC GET endpoints: app.bsky.feed.searchPosts, app.bsky.actor.searchActors, and app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed. Auth is optional but recommended: when both bluesky_handle and bluesky_app_password are set, the node POSTs com.atproto.server.createSession to https://bsky.social/xrpc and uses Authorization Bearer accessJwt against https://api.bsky.app/xrpc (no public fallback). With neither credential, it uses https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc and may receive HTTP 403 during Bluesky load-reduction. Default action is search_posts. Sort for post search is latest (default) or top. Date-only since/until values (YYYY-MM-DD) are expanded to UTC timestamps (until is exclusive end-of-day by adding 1 day). Pagination: pass output.cursor back as input.cursor until cursor is null. Does not post, like, or reply. Users must comply with Bluesky's Terms of Service and rate limits; the customer owns Bluesky credentials stored on their daemon. Example input: {"action":"search_posts","query":"workflow automation","sort":"latest","limit":25}. Bluesky Terms of Service: https://bsky.social/about/support/tos.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Bluesky search request. Required keys depend on action: search_posts and search_actors need query (alias q); get_author_feed needs actor. Optional: action, sort, since, until, lang, limit, cursor. The daemon delivers this object as inputVariables.input (or currentNode.inputList targetPortValue=input). Example: {"action":"search_posts","query":"workflow rate limit","sort":"latest","since":"2026-03-01","until":"2026-03-15","lang":"en","limit":50}.

schema.label: action
schema.description: XRPC operation to run. EXACT accepted values (case-sensitive): 'search_posts' (default when omitted or blank; GET app.bsky.feed.searchPosts; requires query or alias q), 'search_actors' (GET app.bsky.actor.searchActors; requires query or alias q), 'get_author_feed' (GET app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed; requires actor as handle or DID). Any other string sets output.error to 'Unknown action: {action}. Use search_posts, search_actors, or get_author_feed.' and does not call Bluesky. Example: 'search_posts'.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Search text for search_posts and search_actors. Sent as XRPC query parameter q. Alias: if query is blank, the node also reads input field q (same string; q is not a separate schema field). Required for those two actions; ignored by get_author_feed. Bluesky keyword/hashtag search; phrases such as 'workflow automation' are valid. Blank/omitted on search_posts → output.error 'query is required for search_posts action.'; on search_actors → 'query is required for search_actors action.'. Example: 'studioquack'.

schema.label: sort
schema.description: Post ranking for search_posts only (ignored by search_actors and get_author_feed). EXACT accepted values passed through to app.bsky.feed.searchPosts: 'latest' (default when omitted or blank; reverse-chronological) | 'top' (engagement/popularity). Other strings are forwarded to Bluesky as-is and may be rejected by AppView. Example: 'latest'.

schema.label: since
schema.description: Inclusive start of the post-search window (search_posts only). EXACT accepted shapes: blank/omitted → filter omitted; date-only YYYY-MM-DD → UTC midnight that day (example '2026-03-01' becomes '2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z'); other ISO-8601 datetimes (with or without Z/offset; naive treated as UTC) → UTC with millisecond precision and Z suffix. Bluesky rejects bare YYYY-MM-DD on the live API, which is why date-only values are expanded. Example: '2026-03-01T00:00:00Z'.

schema.label: until
schema.description: End of the post-search window (search_posts only). EXACT accepted shapes: blank/omitted → filter omitted; date-only YYYY-MM-DD → UTC midnight of the NEXT calendar day so the named day is inclusive (example '2026-03-15' becomes '2026-03-16T00:00:00.000Z'); other ISO-8601 datetimes → UTC milliseconds + Z, no extra day. Use a full timestamp when you need an exclusive cutoff at a specific instant. Example: '2026-03-15T23:59:59.000Z'.

schema.label: lang
schema.description: Language filter for search_posts (ignored by other actions). EXACT accepted values: ISO 639-1 two-letter codes as understood by app.bsky.feed.searchPosts (example 'en', 'es', 'ja'). Blank/omitted → no lang parameter. Example: 'en'.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size for the chosen action. EXACT accepted values: integers; omitted → configuration default_limit (default 50); values above 100 are capped at 100 (XRPC max). Applies to search_posts, search_actors, and get_author_feed. Example: 25.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Opaque Bluesky pagination cursor. EXACT accepted values: omit or blank on the first page; on later pages pass the previous output.cursor unchanged (do not invent or parse it). When output.cursor is null or absent, there is no further page. Works for search_posts, search_actors, and get_author_feed independently. Example: the string returned in output.cursor from the prior invoke.

schema.label: actor
schema.description: Whose feed to read for get_author_feed (ignored by other actions). EXACT accepted values: a Bluesky handle (example 'jay.bsky.team' or a custom-domain handle) or a DID (example 'did:plc:ewvi7nxzyoun6zhxrhs64tht'). Blank/omitted → output.error 'actor (handle or DID) is required for get_author_feed.'. Example: 'user.bsky.social'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Single output object. Success: status='ok' plus either posts[] (search_posts / get_author_feed) or actors[] (search_actors), a count field, and cursor (string or null for pagination). The handler never returns accessJwt or the app password. Example success: {"status":"ok","posts_returned":2,"cursor":null,"posts":[{"uri":"at://did:plc:…/app.bsky.feed.post/…","text":"…"}]}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on success only. EXACT accepted value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: Posts Returned
schema.description: Count of posts[] in this page (search_posts and get_author_feed). Integer, 0..limit. Absent on search_actors and on failure. Example: 50.

schema.label: Actors Returned
schema.description: Count of actors[] in this page (search_actors only). Integer, 0..limit. Absent on post actions and on failure. Example: 10.

schema.label: Cursor
schema.description: Bluesky pagination token for the next page of the same action. EXACT accepted values from the API: a non-empty opaque string (pass back as input.cursor) or null/absent when this is the last page. Do not mix cursors across actions. Example: 'abcdef0123456789'.

schema.label: Posts
schema.description: Normalized posts for search_posts and get_author_feed. search_posts item keys: uri, text, created_at, like_count, repost_count, reply_count, author_handle, author_display_name, indexed_at, embed (AT Protocol embed object or null). get_author_feed item keys: uri, text, created_at, like_count, repost_count, reply_count, author_handle only (no display name / indexed_at / embed). Counts are integers defaulting to 0. Absent on search_actors. Example: [{"uri":"at://did:plc:abc/app.bsky.feed.post/xyz","text":"hello","author_handle":"user.bsky.social","like_count":3}].

schema.label: Actors
schema.description: Normalized profiles for search_actors only. EXACT item keys: handle, display_name, description, followers_count, follows_count, posts_count, avatar (CDN URL or empty string). Counts are integers defaulting to 0. Absent on post actions. Example: [{"handle":"jay.bsky.team","display_name":"Jay","followers_count":1000}].

configurationParameters.label: Bluesky Handle
configurationParameters.description: AT Protocol identifier used as createSession identifier (handle, custom-domain handle, or the email Bluesky accepts for login). Required together with bluesky_app_password for authenticated AppView calls. EXACT accepted values: non-blank string after trim; blank/omitted with a blank password → public API (https://public.api.bsky.app/xrpc). Example: 'yourname.bsky.social'. Setup: create a Bluesky account, put this handle here, then generate an App Password at https://bsky.app/settings/app-passwords.

configurationParameters.label: Bluesky App Password
configurationParameters.description: Bluesky App Password exchanged for a short-lived accessJwt via POST https://bsky.social/xrpc/com.atproto.server.createSession with JSON {identifier, password}. EXACT accepted values: the generated app-password string (not the account login password); blank/omitted → skip session, use public API. HTTP 401 → output.error 'Bluesky Auth Error: Bluesky authentication failed (401). Check your handle ('{handle}') and app password. Generate an app password at: https://bsky.app/settings/app-passwords'. The JWT is used only for this invoke (never cached) as Authorization: Bearer and is never written to output or logs. Example: a password created at bsky.app → Settings → App Passwords → Add App Password.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout for createSession and each XRPC GET (connect+read via the shared client). EXACT accepted values: positive integers; omitted, 0, or non-numeric → 25. Retries on 429/403 sleep extra (2s, then 4s, then 6s) on top of this budget. Example: 25.

configurationParameters.label: Default Limit
configurationParameters.description: Page size when input.limit is omitted. EXACT accepted values: integers; omitted or non-numeric → 50; the effective limit is still capped at 100. Applies to search_posts, search_actors, and get_author_feed. Example: 50.
